search_scope: Custom workspace auth patterns in routes - enforceWorkspaceScoping and manual workspace extraction

pattern_1_manual_workspace_with_enforce_.description: POST/PATCH handlers extract workspaceId from header, call enforceWorkspaceScoping, use withAuth for capability
pattern_1_manual_workspace_with_enforce_.recommendation: Can migrate if withCanonicalEnforcement supports workspace enforcement directly

pattern_2_resolve_server_role.description: Some routes use resolveServerRole() for special role-based auth instead of capability checks
pattern_2_resolve_server_role.recommendation: Requires custom role resolution design - cannot use withCanonicalEnforcement directly

note: Lane 8 patterns involve workspace membership enforcement and custom role resolution. Most are in POST/PATCH handlers still using withEnforcementFull + manual enforceWorkspaceScoping. Some use custom role resolution (resolveServerRole) which requires separate design.
